title: Generic freeness of a full-support coherent module on a reduced irreducible algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume $X$ is Noetherian: locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth], quasi-compact, and quasi-separated (its diagonal is quasi-compact on scheme tests). Modules are sheaves on the small etale ringed site; quasi-coherence is [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and coherent means quasi-coherent with coherent pullbacks on all etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. The support $\operatorname{Supp}(F)$ is the set of points with nonzero geometric stalk, in the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Assume $X$ is reduced (all its etale scheme charts have local rings without nonzero nilpotents), $|X|$ is nonempty and irreducible, and $F$ is coherent with $\operatorname{Supp}(F)=|X|$. There exist a nonempty open subspace $U\subseteq X$, an integer $r\geq1$, and an isomorphism $F|_U\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$. Here an open subspace is representable by open immersions after scheme base change, and the superscript denotes a finite direct sum.

source.place: Tag 07UQ, lemma-prepare-filter-irreducible, proof, second paragraph: dense open schematic locus and shrinking until F is free; the positive-rank conclusion follows from full support.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-quasiseparated-space-dense-scheme-open] to the quasi-separated space $X$, obtaining a dense open scheme $W$. It is nonempty since $X$ is nonempty. The hypothesis on etale scheme charts makes $W$ locally Noetherian and reduced. Choose a nonempty affine member $V$ of a Noetherian affine cover of $W$ [pqf-def-locnoeth]; then $V$ is Noetherian and reduced. Every nonempty open subset of an irreducible space is irreducible: two nonempty relative opens are nonempty opens of $X$, hence intersect. Thus $V$ is integral by [def-pc-integral-scheme].

source.place: Tag 07UQ, lemma-prepare-filter-irreducible, second proof paragraph; dense schematic open from Tag 06NH, spaces-properties-proposition-locally-quasi-separated-open-dense-scheme.

proof.text: Under [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], $F|_V$ corresponds to the Zariski quasi-coherent module $G$ obtained by restriction to open subschemes. The hypothesis that $F$ has coherent pullbacks on etale scheme charts applies to the chart $V\to X$, so this $G$ is coherent. The same equivalence identifies restriction to any open $U\subseteq V$ with the associated etale module of $G|_U$.

Write $\eta$ for the generic point of $V$. By [lem-sc-integral-function-field-affine-fraction], $\mathcal O_{V,\eta}$ is a field. Its maximal ideal is therefore zero, and annihilates $G_\eta$. Apply [lem-pc-c3-coherent-generic-local-free-model] with ambient scheme $V$, integral closed subscheme $V$, identity closed immersion, and coherent module $G$. All its hypotheses hold; identity pushforward is the identity. It gives $r\geq0$ and an open $U\subseteq V$ containing $\eta$, with $G|_U\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$.

source.place: Tag 01YE, lemma-prepare-filter-irreducible, integral case, through the local free model; Tag 01RV, morphisms-lemma-integral-scheme-rational-functions, for the generic stalk field.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence] on $U$ to this isomorphism. Its tensor-pullback description sends each copy of $\mathcal O_U$ to the etale structure module and the finite direct sum to the corresponding finite direct sum, giving $F|_U\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$. Here $U$ is a nonempty open subspace of $X$, since it contains $\eta$ and is open in the open scheme $V$. If $r=0$, then $F|_U=0$; at any geometric point above $\eta\in U$ its stalk is zero. This contradicts $\operatorname{Supp}(F)=|X|$, so $r\geq1$.
